nodes.asset_description: Centered, front-facing modern smartphone (black/space gray aluminum frame) with rounded corners and a prominent black notch at the top of the screen. The screen is bright white. On the upper-center of the display, a minimalist dark slate-blue (#3f5160) line icon shows an envelope with a small notification bell on its upper-right corner. The device casts a soft shadow to the right onto the pink background, and the right side of the background shows a faint darker pink falloff from the shadow.

nodes.svg_description: White rounded-rectangle dialog card with 32–36 px corner radius (smooth, fully rounded corners), centered horizontally. Fill: #ffffff. Soft drop shadow (approx. 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)). Inside the card, a thin horizontal divider line spans full width near the bottom to separate action buttons; stroke color #edd6d6 at y ≈ card_top + 360 px. A single thin vertical divider line splits the lower button area into two equal halves; same stroke color #edd6d6, positioned at the exact horizontal center of the card from the horizontal divider down to the bottom edge.
